verdicts.reason: A keeps the white frame with corner nodes and the brand orange tint, so it reads as the same design. But the frame is empty, the reading order is jumbled (tickets text sits above the 'Theatre presents' line), the copy is cramped with uneven sizes, and the oversized play icon in the bottom bar is cropped at the left edge. B loses the white frame and turns the orange panel into a blank block over a dark, purple-shifted image, so the brand colour and feel are damaged. B has the same jumbled text order, a faint box artifact next to the icon, and a play icon jammed into the corner.
